result.question: How does Abimelech kill Shechem's leaders?

readings.answer: By burning them in the tower—piling branches against the inner chamber and setting it on fire
readings.support: Then they piled the branches against the inner chamber and set it on fire above them, killing everyone in the tower of Shechem

assessments.reason: The passage states they piled branches against the inner chamber and set it on fire, killing everyone in the tower of Shechem; this matches “sets tower on fire.”

result.reason: The text explicitly says Abimelech burned the tower of Shechem, killing those inside.
